notes.window: full window = the model's own maximum input length (8,192 tokens for bge-reranker-v2-m3, 1,024 for jina-reranker-v2-base-multilingual); the banked run truncated every (query, résumé) pair to 512. Same pools, résumé forms, queries, seeds and tie-break keys in both runs.
notes.shares: tie-aware % male-favored (ties count half), as in companion_statistics.py
notes.bootstrap: pools resampled with replacement within each of the 24 job categories, the same draw for both runs; it reflects which résumés were drawn, not which occupations, and the female-typed group has 3 categories
notes.same_winner: winner = male form, female form, or tie (equal scores); by_construction groups follow the 512-token run
notes.hosted_models: scored once, on whole documents (32,000-token windows; Voyage with truncation off, Cohere with max_tokens_per_doc 32000); synthetic_audit_male_minus_female is the model's tie-aware contrast in the synthetic audit (interval_sensitivity.json). Voyage sometimes returns every score rounded to bfloat16; such a request was re-sent, and by_response_precision sets apart the comparisons whose request kept rounded scores
notes.counterbalanced: jina-reranker-v3 is listwise and order-sensitive; its overview row averages each pair's gap over the male-first run and a female-first run, and its synthetic contrast likewise over the audit's same and reversed arms (see COUNTERBALANCED)
notes.random_streams: each model draws its bootstrap and permutations from its own stream, seeded by 20261019 and its short name (model_rng), so adding or dropping a model leaves the others' intervals and p values unchanged
notes.post_audit: models released after the audit (Cohere rerank-v5.0-pro and -fast, 2026-10-21), called on Cohere's own API; their synthetic contrast is the audit's statistic over the same 8,320 retained pairs, scored in October 2026 by code/post_audit_synthetic.py (results/post_audit/<model>_synthetic.json), not by the audit

full_window_config.batching: length-sorted, both forms of a (query, resume) in one batch, identical truncated inputs scored once

bootstrap.resampling: pools within each job category, paired
